```{=html}
<main class="taxonomy-study" id="study-root">
  <header class="study-header">
    <p class="study-eyebrow">MLSYSBOOK · ALL FOUR VOLUMES</p>
    <div class="study-heading-line"><h1>Concept Explorer</h1><span class="study-draft-label">Draft</span></div>
    <p class="study-intro">Explore the subjects of ML systems and follow the connections between them.</p>
  </header>
  <div class="study-workspace">
    <div class="study-topbar">
      <div class="study-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Explore ML systems">
        <button id="study-tab-tree" type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="study-map">Taxonomy</button>
        <button id="study-tab-connections" type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="study-map" tabindex="-1">Concept map</button>
      </div>
      <div class="study-header-actions"><label for="study-search" class="study-sr">Find a subject or concept</label><input id="study-search" type="search" placeholder="Find a subject or concept…" autocomplete="off"><a id="study-expand" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Expand ↗</a></div>
    </div>
    <div class="study-navigation-row">
      <nav id="study-breadcrumb" class="study-breadcrumb" aria-label="Current place in the taxonomy"></nav>
      <div class="study-map-tools">
        <select id="study-taxonomy-layout" aria-label="Taxonomy layout"><option value="nested">Cards</option><option value="tree">Tree</option></select>
        <select id="study-connection-scope" aria-label="Concept map scope" hidden><option value="full">Full map</option><option value="local">Neighborhood</option></select>
        <button id="study-overview" type="button" title="Return to all subjects">Overview</button>
        <button id="study-fit" type="button" title="Fit the drawing in the available space">Fit</button>
        <span class="study-zoom-buttons"><button id="study-minus" type="button" aria-label="Zoom out">−</button><button id="study-plus" type="button" aria-label="Zoom in">+</button></span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="study-map-layout">
      <section id="study-map" class="study-map" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="study-tab-tree" tabindex="0" aria-label="Interactive map. Drag to pan. Control or Command and scroll to zoom. Arrow keys pan; plus and minus zoom; Home fits the map.">
        <div id="study-world" class="study-world"><svg id="study-edges" aria-hidden="true"></svg><div id="study-nodes"></div></div>
        <div id="study-search-results" class="study-search-results" hidden></div><p id="study-loading" class="study-loading">Loading concepts…</p>
      </section>
      <section id="study-reader" class="study-reader" aria-labelledby="study-reader-title" hidden><div class="study-reader-top"><span id="study-reader-kind"></span><button id="study-close" type="button" aria-label="Close detail panel">×</button></div><div id="study-detail"></div></section>
    </div>
    <div class="study-map-footer"><p id="study-status" role="status">Explore the subjects and their connections.</p><span>Drag to pan · Ctrl/⌘ + scroll to zoom</span></div>
  </div>
  <details class="study-method"><summary>About this draft and downloads</summary><div><p id="study-scope"></p><p>The taxonomy groups subjects. The concept map shows authored relationships, each with conditions. These structures do not prescribe a learning sequence or establish complete coverage of the field.</p><p>Book links point to candidate related passages. Missing links mean the alignment is unfinished; they do not establish missing book coverage.</p><p><a href="framework-reference.md" download>Definitions and method</a> · <a href="framework-table.csv" download>Taxonomic table</a> · <a href="framework-atlas.svg" download>Static taxonomy</a> · <a href="field-all.svg" download>Full concept map</a> · <a href="volume-maps.html">Maps by volume</a></p><p id="study-version"></p></div></details>
  <noscript><p>Open the <a href="framework-reference.md">written framework</a> or <a href="framework-atlas.svg">static taxonomy</a> to explore without JavaScript.</p></noscript>
</main>
<script src="study.js" defer></script>
```
